title: You-Go
subtitle: Flip the rules — turn-based card battle

draw.label: Draw
draw.description: Next player draws N cards (light=dark's drawCount)

wild.label: Wild
wild.description: Play anytime, choose the next color

wilddraw.label: Wild Draw
wilddraw.description: Play anytime, choose color, next player draws N (light=dark's wildDrawCount)

flip.label: You-Go!
flip.description: Flips the entire game to the opposite side (all hands, deck, discard)

rules.playMatching: Match the top card of the discard pile by color, number, or symbol
rules.wildPlayable: Wild and Wild Draw cards can be played on any card
rules.flipPlayable: Flip (You-Go!) cards can be played on any card, ensure all players are playing the same side of cards, players should never be playing light against dark
rules.flipEffect: When a Flip card is played, every card in every player's hand flips to the opposite side's colors. The deck and discard pile also flip. The turn continues.
rules.drawOnNoMatch: If you cannot or choose not to play, draw one card. Your turn then passes.
rules.drawnCardPlayable: A drawn card cannot be played immediately — the turn passes after drawing.
rules.wildColorChoice: After playing a Wild or Wild Draw card, pick a color. The wild card just played turn that colour to indicate to other players. The discard continues with that color.
rules.shuffleDiscardIntoDeck: When the deck runs out, shuffle the discard pile (keeping the top card) into a new deck
rules.winCondition: First player to empty their hand wins the round
rules.turnOrder: Turns pass clockwise by default. Reverse changes direction. Skip skips the next player.
rules.drawCardAmounts: Draw cards force the next player to draw (light drawN / dark drawN). Wild Draw cards force the next player to draw (light wildDrawN / dark wildDrawN).

deckComposition.notes: Each side is built independently. Numbers 1-9, plus action cards, plus globals (wild/wilddraw/flip). Total cards per side = sum below.

notes: Light side colors (pastel): yellow, green, blue, red
Dark side colors (neon on black): pink, yellow, green, blue
When the deck/side flips, a colour must be assumed, the first card placed in discard pile will now be on top, assume the opposite flip side of that card
Wild cards have no color — they use a dark card back with a rainbow overlay
The game is local-only (single device, pass-and-play)
